acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins bound to kinobeads were eluted with LDS sample buffer (NuPAGE, Thermo Fisher Scientific) containing 50 mM DTT and alkylated with 55 mM CAA.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins bound to kinobeads were eluted with LDS sample buffer (NuPAGE, Thermo Fisher Scientific) containing 50 mM DTT and alkylated with 55 mM CAA.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Kinobead pulldown eluates were purified by short SDS-PAGE (ca. 1 cm; Thermo Fisher Scientific) and were subsequently subjected to in-gel tryptic digestion according to standard procedures.
Trypsin/P was specified as the proteolytic enzyme and up to two missed cleavage sites were allowed.

collision_energy.evidence: Up to 12 peptide precursors were selected for fragmentation by higher energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD; 1.3 m/z isolation window, AGC value of 1 x e5, maximum injection time of 22 ms) using 28% normalized collision energy (NCE) and analyzed at a resolution of 15,000 in the Orbitrap.

labeling.evidence: Label-free quantification and data matching were enabled within MaxQuant.

mass_analyzer.evidence: LC-MS/MS measurement of peptides in eluates was performed using an UltiMate 3000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to a quadrupole-Orbitrap Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
